Messages.Author: henrik isaksson
Messages.Body:
Veil of darkness:
If the first card a vampire plays is an action card, and the top card is a
master card, is that vampire tapped or what? If not, can he do the same
action?

Also, if the first card requires Obt, does the vampire burn two blood even
if the top card is not a master card?

Thirst: When I play this card, does my vampires that didn't hunt (with cap
below nr of gehenna cards) burn blood, or is the check only in the end of
the minion phase?

/henrik isaksson

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
henrik isaksson wrote:
> Veil of darkness:
> If the first card a vampire plays is an action card, and the top card is a
> master card, is that vampire tapped or what? If not, can he do the same
> action?

Or what.
Yes.

> Also, if the first card requires Obt, does the vampire burn two blood even
> if the top card is not a master card?

No. Card text: "If it is a master card, X and in addition if <obt-req>,
<burn 2>"

> Thirst: When I play this card, does my vampires that didn't hunt (with cap
> below nr of gehenna cards) burn blood, or is the check only in the end of
> the minion phase?

The latter, by card text.
